description: This file defines the ConvertLeadUI class, which manages the user interface logic for lead conversion in the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for retrieving lead information, checking module and field statuses, managing owner lists, and handling field mappings.

classes.name: ConvertLeadUI
classes.description: A class to manage all UI-related functionality for lead conversion, including fetching lead data, managing ownership info, and handling field mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConvertLeadUI object by retrieving lead details from the database.

methods.name: isModuleActive
methods.description: Checks if a specified module is active and permitted for editing.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific field in a module is active/visible.

methods.name: isMandatory
methods.description: Determines if a specific field in a module is mandatory.

methods.name: getFieldInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific field in a module.

methods.name: setAssignedToInfo
methods.description: Sets information about the owner (user or group) assigned to the lead.

methods.name: getUserSelected
methods.description: Returns whether a user is selected as owner.

methods.name: getUserDisplay
methods.description: Returns the display status for user selection.

methods.name: getGroupSelected
methods.description: Returns whether a group is selected as owner.

methods.name: getGroupDisplay
methods.description: Returns the display status for group selection.

methods.name: getLeadInfo
methods.description: Returns the lead information fetched during initialization.

methods.name: getDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the date format for the current user.

methods.name: getleadId
methods.description: Returns the lead ID.

methods.name: getCompany
methods.description: Returns the company name from the lead data, HTML-encoded.

methods.name: getIndustryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of industry picklist values.

methods.name: getSalesStageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sales stage picklist values.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the current user's ID.

methods.name: getOwnerList
methods.description: Generates a list of owner options (users or groups) for the lead.

methods.name: checkOwnership
methods.description: Checks if shared ownership of records is private for the user.

methods.name: getMappedFieldValue
methods.description: Returns the mapped value for a given module and field, considering picklist types.
